title: WAL database-size observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3WalDbsize returns the committed WAL header database page count when a non-null WAL has an active read lock, and zero when the size is unknown.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete nullable observation body is assigned; pager/B-tree consumers remain open.

outputs: Header database page count or zero when null/unlocked
contracts.state_and_results: A nonnegative read_lock makes header.database_pages observable; null or negative read_lock returns zero.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callbacks or I/O; active read lock is represented state.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure path and no mutation.

representation_differences: Nullable Zig pointer and signed read_lock model directly represent source null and >=0 checks.

oracle.protocol: Observe zero for null WAL, zero for read_lock -1 with header size 9, and 9 after read_lock becomes 0.
oracle.normalization: Page count and zero unknown sentinel are exact.

assurance.malformed_input: Null/unlocked state safely returns unknown zero.
